x2_build_candidates.purpose: Summarize launch, next-check, watcher mode, and phase-advance blockers without reading raw outputs before the gate.
Use strict stdin as the default CLI lane path after Arby's v3 repair proved it avoids command-bridge stale output.
Use background watch launch for app lanes and harvest only at gate time through curated receipts.
Package repaired split CLI outputs into one notifier and one quality receipt for downstream normalizers.
Keep generic sensitive-marker warnings open until strict quality and marker-review ledgers decide whether a real blocker remains.
Require cadence, app gate, CLI completion, CLI quality, marker review, five-lane normalizer, exposure, and no-overclaim receipts before phase advancement.
Make every x2 phase prove which x1 proposals were built, run, tested, installed, or used, and which stayed queued.

x2_preparation_notes: Do not treat launch success as sibling completion.
Do not treat elapsed time as proof of readiness.
If app background receipts are missing at the gate, use the direct repair gate rather than repeated manual polling.
If either CLI lane is pending at the gate, record carryover and continue productive prep instead of narrowing the run.
If a CLI lane produces short output, repair before phase advance.
Keep all GMUT, canon, consciousness, and final-physics gates open.
